stages.title: Carrier Reports Breakdown
stages.event: Load LD-3051 is traveling from Dallas, TX to Memphis, TN. The carrier reports a mechanical breakdown near Little Rock, AR. Repair completion time is unknown, and delivery is scheduled in four hours.
options: Immediately mark the shipment as delivered.
Verify the breakdown details, current location, repair estimate, and delivery risk with the carrier.
Ignore the situation until the scheduled delivery time.
stages.why: Verify the carrier's report and assess delivery risk before communicating an updated ETA.

stages.title: Delivery Appointment at Risk
stages.event: The carrier confirms the repair may take three hours. The original delivery appointment is now at risk.
options: Notify authorized stakeholders, coordinate receiver acceptance or rescheduling, and document the carrier-reported ETA.
Promise that the shipment will arrive on time.
Change the appointment without contacting the receiver.
stages.why: A revised ETA is not a confirmed appointment. Coordinate with the authorized parties and record the outcome.

stages.title: After-Hours Shift Handover
stages.event: Your shift ends in 15 minutes. The repair is ongoing, and the receiver has not confirmed a new appointment.
options: Tell the next shift that everything is fine.
Document verified facts, pending appointment, contact history, escalation status, owner, and next follow-up time.
stages.why: An unresolved shipment exception requires a complete and actionable handover.

cases.name: AI Tracking Error and ETA Conflict

stages.title: AI Tracking Alert
stages.event: Load LD-4082 is traveling from Chicago, IL to Columbus, OH. Automated tracking predicts a two-hour delay, but the carrier previously reported an on-time ETA.
options: Immediately notify the customer that delivery is delayed.
Compare GPS timestamps, review the carrier update, and verify the latest shipment status.
stages.why: AI predictions are not verified shipment facts. Conflicting information must be investigated.

stages.title: Conflicting ETA Updates
stages.event: The carrier confirms a revised ETA of 8:30 PM ET, but the automated tracking system still shows 7:15 PM ET.
options: Document the verified carrier update, assess the appointment impact, and flag the conflicting automated ETA according to SOP.
Assume the automated ETA is always correct.
stages.why: Preserve the audit trail and distinguish the confirmed carrier report from potentially stale automated data.

stages.title: Automated Delivery Confirmation
stages.event: The truck enters the receiver geofence. The system automatically marks the shipment Delivered, but unloading has not started.
options: Flag or correct the premature status through authorized procedures, verify unloading, and obtain required delivery evidence.
stages.why: Geofence arrival does not establish completed delivery. Delivery confirmation and required documentation must be verified.
